title: Audio Agent Workbench V2
summary: The current Bouch workbench for agent-driven electronic music production and sound design in REAPER. Start here for any audio creation task: it records the capability map and demonstrated gaps, Skills for assembling arrangements and loading Surge XT patches or DecentSampler instruments, a production-technique reasoning corpus, offline tools for render verification, and per-experiment evidence. Requires a running REAPER with the reaper-mcp Lua bridge.

source.note: Not yet published to a remote repository.

entrypoints.title: Workbench contract: evidence rules and skill routing
Capability map, demonstrated gaps and next acceptance slice
Electronic production technique corpus: synthesis, layering, EQ, compression, sidechain, reverb
Assemble, render and verify an arrangement
Load a designed Surge XT synth patch
Offline tools: render analysis, drum pattern mixdown, sample extraction
Per-experiment evidence (sound palette, sidechain, sampling, patch loading)
